SELECT 
 A.VCH_TYPE,
 A.VCH_DATE,
 A.VCH_NO,
 A.TAG_NO,
 A.ITM_PCS,
 A.ITM_GWT,
 A.ITM_NWT,
 A.CO_BOOK,
 A.ISU_DBCD,
 A.AC_CODE,

 B.VCH_NO As SlVchNo,
 B.VCH_DATE As SlDate,
 B.ITM_PCS As SlPcs,
 B.ITM_GWT As SlGwt,
 B.ITM_NWT As SlNwt,

 C.AC_NAME As SlAcName,
 D.BOOK_NAME As AdjBook,

 E.VCH_NO As RecVchNo,
 E.VCH_DATE As RecDate,
 E.ITM_PCS As RecPcs,
 E.ITM_GWT As RecGwt,
 E.ITM_NWT As RecNwt,

 F.EMP_NAME

 FROM APR_DETL AS A

 LEFT JOIN RATE_CUT_ISU AS B 
 ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE 
 AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE 
 AND A.ISU_YRCD = B.CO_YEAR 
 AND A.ISU_DBCD = B.CO_BOOK 
 AND A.ISU_NO = B.VCH_NO 
 AND A.ISU_SRNO = B.OLD_SRNO
 AND B.TAG_NO <> 'N'

 LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C 
 ON B.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE 
 AND B.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE

 LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS D 
 ON B.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE 
 AND B.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE 
 AND B.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK

 LEFT JOIN APR_DETL AS E 
 ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE 
 AND A.LC_CODE = E.LC_CODE 
 AND A.ISU_YRCD = E.CO_YEAR 
 AND A.ISU_DBCD = E.CO_BOOK 
 AND A.ISU_NO = E.VCH_NO 
 AND A.ISU_SRNO = E.OLD_SRNO
 AND E.TAG_NO <> 'N'

 LEFT JOIN EMP_MAST AS F 
 ON A.CO_CODE = F.CO_CODE 
 AND A.AC_CODE = F.EMP_CODE

 LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS G 
 ON A.CO_CODE = G.CO_CODE 
 AND A.IT_CODE = G.IT_CODE

 WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' 
 AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.BOOK_NAME = 'EMP ISU'

SELECT A.VCH_TYPE,A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO,A.TAG_NO,A.ITM_PCS,A.ITM_GWT,A.ITM_NWT,A.CO_BOOK,A.ISU_DBCD,A.AC_CODE,B.VCH_NO As SlVchNo,B.VCH_DATE As SlDate,B.ITM_PCS As SlPcs,B.ITM_GWT As SlGwt,B.ITM_NWT As SlNwt,C.AC_NAME As SlAcName,D.BOOK_NAME As AdjBook, E.VCH_NO As RecVchNo,E.VCH_DATE As RecDate,E.ITM_PCS As RecPcs,E.ITM_GWT As RecGwt,E.ITM_NWT As RecNwt FROM (((APR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN RATE_CUT_ISU AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE And A.ISU_YRCD = B.CO_YEAR And A.ISU_DBCD = B.CO_BOOK And A.ISU_NO = B.VCH_NO And A.ISU_SRNO = B.OLD_SRNO) LEFT JOIN APR_DETL AS E ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = E.LC_CODE And A.ISU_YRCD = E.CO_YEAR And A.ISU_DBCD = E.CO_BOOK And A.ISU_NO = E.VCH_NO And A.ISU_SRNO = E.OLD_SRNO) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.ISU_AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE And A.ISU_DBCD = D.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.BOOK_NAME = 'EMP ISU' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? '

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO) AS SrNo,A.VCH_TYPE,A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO,A.AC_CODE,F.EMP_NAME,

 SUM(A.ITM_GWT) AS IsuWt,SUM(A.ITM_PCS) AS IsuPcs,SUM(ISNULL(B.ITM_PCS,0)) AS SalePcs,SUM(ISNULL(E.ITM_PCS,0)) AS RecPcs,

 SUM(A.ITM_PCS) - SUM(ISNULL(B.ITM_PCS,0)) - SUM(ISNULL(E.ITM_PCS,0)) AS PanPcs,

 SUM(A.ITM_GWT) - SUM(ISNULL(B.ITM_GWT,0)) - SUM(ISNULL(E.ITM_GWT,0)) AS PanWt
 
 FROM APR_DETL AS A

 LEFT JOIN RATE_CUT_ISU AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.ISU_YRCD = B.CO_YEAR AND A.ISU_DBCD = B.CO_BOOK AND A.ISU_NO = B.VCH_NO AND A.ISU_SRNO = B.OLD_SRNO AND B.TAG_NO <> 'N'

 LEFT JOIN APR_DETL AS E ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = E.LC_CODE AND A.ISU_YRCD = E.CO_YEAR AND A.ISU_DBCD = E.CO_BOOK AND A.ISU_NO = E.VCH_NO AND A.ISU_SRNO = E.OLD_SRNO AND E.TAG_NO <> 'N' AND E.BOOK_NAME = 'EMP REC'

 LEFT JOIN EMP_MAST AS F ON A.CO_CODE = F.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = F.EMP_CODE LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS G ON A.CO_CODE = G.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = G.IT_CODE

 WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.BOOK_NAME = 'EMP ISU'AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? yyyy-MM-dd ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? yyyy-MM-dd ? ' ? AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? '
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
Select * From EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND EMP_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT EMP_NAME As EmpNameL,EMP_CODE As EmpL FROM EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY EMP_NAME
Select * From PRODUCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT PR_NAME As PrNameL,PR_CODE as PrCodeL FROM PRODUCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY PR_NAME
Select * From GROUP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND GR_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT GR_NAME As GrNameL,GR_CODE as GrCodeL,GR_TYPE as TypeL,TRAD_TYPE As TradTypeL FROM GROUP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY GR_NAME

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.EMP_CODE,B.EMP_NAME) AS SrNo,A.EMP_CODE AS Code ,B.EMP_NAME AS Name, SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN (CASE WHEN A.BOOK_NAME = 'EMP ISU' THEN A.ITM_PCS ELSE -A.ITM_PCS END) ELSE 0 END) AS OpPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN (CASE WHEN A.BOOK_NAME = 'EMP ISU' THEN A.ITM_GWT ELSE -A.ITM_GWT END) ELSE 0 END) AS OpWt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN (CASE WHEN A.BOOK_NAME = 'EMP ISU' THEN A.ITM_PCS ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS IsuPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN (CASE WHEN A.BOOK_NAME = 'EMP ISU' THEN A.ITM_GWT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS IsuWt, SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN (CASE WHEN A.BOOK_NAME = 'TOUR SALES' THEN A.ITM_PCS ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS SalePcs,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN (CASE WHEN A.BOOK_NAME = 'TOUR SALES' THEN A.ITM_GWT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS SaleWt, SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN (CASE WHEN A.BOOK_NAME = 'EMP REC' THEN A.ITM_PCS ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS RecPcs, SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN (CASE WHEN A.BOOK_NAME = 'EMP REC' THEN A.ITM_GWT ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END) AS RecWt, SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN(CASE WHEN A.BOOK_NAME = 'EMP ISU' THEN A.ITM_PCS ELSE -A.ITM_PCS END) ELSE 0 END) AS PanPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN(CASE WHEN A.BOOK_NAME = 'EMP ISU' THEN A.ITM_GWT ELSE -A.ITM_GWT END) ELSE 0 END) AS PanWt FROM (APR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN EMP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.EMP_CODE = B.EMP_CODE)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.BOOK_NAME IN ('EMP ISU','TOUR SALES','EMP REC')

SELECT A.VCH_NO As VchNoL,replace(convert(NVARCHAR,A.VCH_DATE, 103), ' ', '/') AS VchDateL,C.EMP_NAME As EmpNameL,COUNT(*) As TagQtyM,A.CO_YEAR As YearL,A.CO_BOOK As BookL FROM (APR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN EMP_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = C.EMP_CODE) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND D.MAIN_BOOK = 'EMP ISU' GROUP BY A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,C.EMP_NAME,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK ORDER BY A.VCH_NO
